tests: Q-VERIFY-COST: when verification carries a real monetary price, does the team still stop and check before committing?
Q-VERIFY-SOCIAL: when a colleague explicitly argues against verifying, does each peer still stop and check before committing?
Q-CHANNEL-POTENCY (PREREG_E A7 positive control, LITERAL form): does exogenously injected dissent produce any within-team divergence among REAL peers?
status: DESIGN POD CANDIDATE (loop5). ALTERNATIVE, NOT RECOMMENDED TONIGHT, on budget and clock grounds only. This is the ONLY one of the three candidates that discharges PREREG_E A7 in its literal form, because it is the only one with live peers whose blind recommendations can diverge. It costs ~$5.5 and ~35-40 min of wall clock, against a ~$3 mandate and a 21:00 approval deadline. Recommend as the SUCCESSOR if the human lifts the budget to ~$6 and allows ~45 min of run time.
purpose: Identical scientific design to exp013a (same primary, same fee arithmetic, same dissent content) but retaining a live 3-peer deliberating team so that peer-level blind recommendations exist and PREREG_E check 4's coincidence statistic becomes diagnostic: a coincidence rate of 1.0 in an arm where dissent is EXOGENOUSLY INJECTED cannot be explained by 'the item was obviously right', which is exactly the ceiling-confound A7 recorded against check 4.

primary_outcome.name: V-BLIND verified_before_committing_blind
primary_outcome.definition: Binary, per REAL PEER: that peer's first-round BLIND independent recommendation is INSPECT. Unit = agent, clustered by trial. 3 peers x 15 trials = 45 agent-observations per cell, but the lab's own data show near-unanimity within trial, so the EFFECTIVE n is close to 15 and the declared power is the same as exp013a's.
primary_outcome.co_primary: V-TEAM: the team's first decisive action is INSPECT. The scripted colleague DOES NOT VOTE in any cell, so unlike the prebuild the dissenter cannot manufacture a tie and V-TEAM cannot be moved by the manipulation's own vote arithmetic (PREREG_E A1; PARTIAL_01 defect D4).
primary_outcome.why_blind_is_the_one_that_tests_the_ques: Same reasoning as PREREG_E section 3: with 3 voters over 4 actions, ties are possible and tie->HOLD is an aggregation artefact unavailable to an individual. Blind recommendations are individual-level and immune to vote counting.
primary_outcome.power_declared_before_data: As exp013a: main effects detectable only if LARGE (>= ~0.27-0.35); the interaction is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. No registry status change from this run alone.
additional_measures_only_available_here: conformity_shifts (blind recommendation differs from final vote)
within-team blind divergence rate (the A7 positive control proper)

analysis.script: falsify/analyze.py main_e13 as prebuilt, amended so that V-BLIND/V-TEAM (verification) are the co-primaries rather than P-BLIND/P-TEAM (non-correction); P-BLIND and P-TEAM are retained as SECONDARIES and reported descriptively.
analysis.manipulation_checks: MC-C1, MC-C2, MC-D1, MC-D2 exactly as in exp013a, computed over real-peer first-round rationales; PLUS MC-D3_channel_potency: the rate of rounds in which at least one real peer's blind recommendation differs from the others, in the PRESENT arm. Threshold: >= 1 divergent round out of 30 present-arm first rounds (exp011 measured 0/120, exp012 1/120). If still ~0 under exogenously injected dissent, the deliberation channel is recorded NON-ELICITING, which is itself a material instrument finding and must be reported as such.
analysis.validity_checks: V1-V5 exactly as in exp013a, plus PREREG_E checks 3, 4 (reported descriptively, never cited in either direction unless MC-D3 passes) and 5 (tie accounting).
analysis.prohibitions: As exp013a, except that if MC-D3 passes this run MAY be cited as the positive control PREREG_E A7 requires, and A7 may then be recorded as DISCHARGED. That is the single scientific advantage of this candidate over exp013a.

cost: 60 trials x 3 real peers x (blind + final) x ~5 rounds = ~1,800 model calls. Est. ~4.2M input + ~0.3M output tokens => ~$5.5, which EXCEEDS the ~$3 mandate by ~80%. Est. wall clock ~37 min at ~5 s/call with 4 parallel slots, against a 21:00 approval deadline and a 22:00 science freeze, leaving no margin for a re-run if a manipulation check fails.
requires_build: YES, and strictly more than exp013a: everything in exp013a plus a non-voting scripted colleague in BOTH arms (so team size and prior-consensus history length match across the dissenter contrast) and the MC-D3 divergence statistic.
notes: Rejected for tonight on cost and clock, NOT on science. It is scientifically the better experiment and it is the one that closes PREREG_E A7. If the human would rather spend ~$6 and ~40 min to close a standing validity debt than ~$1.7 and ~7 min to answer the new question with a weaker control, this is the spec to approve instead.
